fact: The Automated National Civil Status Register, under the Ministry of the Interior, connects all municipalities, their administrative annexes and consular offices abroad, and includes birth, marriage and death records.
title: Digital Transformation and Administrative Modernization: The Implementation of Electronic Municipalities in Algeria within the Framework of the e-Government Strategy
publisher: Science, Education and Innovations in the Context of Modern Problems (IMCRA), Zahag El Mouatassim Billeh
